message: `Nest[Integer]` cannot be passed to or from an external function in this version
notes: the types that can be passed are Integer, Integer8, Integer16, Integer32, Float, Float32, Boolean, Character, String, Byte, UnsignedInteger16, UnsignedInteger32, UnsignedInteger64, Bytes, List, Map, Set[D] as flags when D is a data type with 1 to 32 constructors that take no arguments, Option, Result, Pair, Triple, records and `data` types with concrete type arguments that are not recursive (including a single-constructor data type passed as a tuple), and Unit as a result
recursive types cannot be passed, including recursion through List or other types
the dependency cycle includes the declaration of `Nest`
